about: The old Trillion app's features move into the Workshop byte for byte. Groups come from the rows of Trillion's capabilities.json that name moves_to. Engine pieces (sign-in and the door, the stores, the Worker entry) stay: they are ported to Rust, not moved. Provider calls (Durable Object storage, KV, env bindings) are swapped for the records door's calls by the calls rows; a group with a provider call no row swaps is held. The KV rows swap only to calls the records door offers (read and write at @own-records) and need a door the caller hands in; a credential read from an env binding has no call swap, because the door hands credentials by handle through the tool row's invoke.connection, so such a group is held until its row declares that. Groups with no moves_to row are listed by hand in groups.

calls.means: A KV read of one JSON entry becomes records:read at @own-records: the record kind is the binding's name, the id the key.
A KV write of one JSON text becomes records:write at @own-records of that value.
A KV delete becomes records:write of null for that id.

keep_reasons.src/record-model-tools.mjs: tools/record-graph already holds it; what only the old file has is merged there and the old file deleted, not moved as a second copy.
